company_type: Early-stage Indian climate-tech startup, founded Dec 2022 — IIT Roorkee + IIM-A founders

technology.technology_name: Fly-Ash / GGBS Binder for Cement Replacement (Concrete Binder)
technology.description: CarbonStrong produces a binder for concrete that replaces ordinary Portland cement with fly ash and blast-furnace slag (industrial byproducts of thermal power and steel production). Founded December 2022 by an IIT Roorkee engineer + IIM Ahmedabad graduate. Targets cement reduction in concrete by partial-to-full substitution depending on application.
technology.problem_solved: Indian thermal power plants generate ~270 MT of fly ash annually, much of which contaminates water bodies. Steel mills produce slag in bulk. Using these as cement substitute lowers concrete CO2 footprint by 40–80% and reduces hazardous waste.
technology.innovation_summary: Custom formulation of fly-ash/GGBS binder validated against IS 456 compressive strength tests at 28-day and 90-day intervals; demand-driven product per founder interview.
technology.unique_selling_points: Indian-context formulation; direct customer demand from concrete producers and builders; founder team mix of engineering + commercial
technology.application_area: Ready-mix concrete plants, precast manufacturers, infrastructure contractors
technology.target_industries: RMC plants, infrastructure contractors, real estate developers seeking low-carbon procurement
technology.potential_customers: Mid-tier RMC operators; carbon-conscious developers; NHAI / metro contractors with sustainability mandates
technology.institution_name: Founder origins: IIT Roorkee + IIM Ahmedabad
technology.estimated_market_size: Indian cement market ₹4 Lakh Cr; addressable substitution market ~₹40,000 Cr
technology.preferred_license_type: Patent Buyout for territorial / industry exclusivity; Quick License for non-exclusive
technology.upfront_cost: ₹5–50L typical for a single RMC plant; ₹1–3 Cr for state-wide exclusivity
technology.certification_status: IS 456 compressive strength compliance under test; targeting IGBC GreenPro listing
technology.routing_tier: Patent Buyout (small-medium tier) — fits NRDC startup-incubation programme
